title: Member Onboarding: Role Suggester & Contextual Assignment Wizard
creator: Priya Shah
description: Design a guided onboarding flow for adding members to the Console that recommends roles based on SSO/SAML group mappings, recent audit events, and product usage patterns. The wizard should let admins preview effective permissions, show risk/least-privilege suggestions, and record the decision to audit logs. It aims to reduce over-permissioning during user onboarding and speed up bulk assignments with safeguards.
background_and_goals: Problem: Admins frequently over-assign broad roles during onboarding because the current role editor surface requires deep knowledge of permission sets.
Goal 1: Provide contextual role suggestions using SSO group signals and historical team activity.
Goal 2: Let admins preview effective access (what features and data the user will access) before confirming.
Goal 3: Integrate explicit audit records and an optional approval step for high-risk permissions.
Goal 4: Support single and bulk user flows, with quick undo and time-limited temporary role options.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard available from Console team and user lists (single and bulk entry points).
Role suggestions powered by SSO group mappings and a lightweight heuristic using last-90-day activity are shown with confidence scores.
Effective-permissions preview shows feature-level and resource-level access in plain language and example scenarios.
Admin can opt into a one-click least-privilege suggestion that narrows permissions and shows delta from requested role.
Every assignment writes a structured audit entry with reason, suggestion source, and approver (if used).
Temporary role assignments can be set with duration; expiration emits an audit event and optional notify action.
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs: We will surface computed suggestions at 3 confidence tiers rather than exact mappings to avoid false assurance from imperfect signals.
Inline preview will show examples instead of full permission lists to reduce cognitive load; full JSON/permission list available via advanced view.
Bulk flow will limit operations to <= 500 users per action to keep latency predictable and to match existing batching limits in backend.
ux_flow_summary: Entry points: team members page, invite modal, SSO provisioning sync screen.
Step 2: Suggestion card showing top 2 role suggestions + confidence and rationale (SSO group, recent ownership, historical role).
Step 3: Effective access preview with toggles to expand feature/resource examples and a risk score.
Step 4: Optional approval and annotation for P0/P1 risk actions; writes to audit log.
Step 5: Confirmation with undo window and optional 'notify user' checkbox.
edge_cases_and_notes: Users without SSO mapping: fallback to usage-based suggestion if activity exists; otherwise show 'manual review required'.
Conflicting suggestions across groups: show merged suggestions and surface conflicts in red with explicit explainer.
Offline/air-gapped Private installs: suggestion engine will run on-device using only synced audit and group metadata; cloud-powered suggestions disabled by default.
accessibility_and_localization: All labels and explanations must meet WCAG AA contrast and screen reader order; provide concise alt text for role rationale icons.
Copy will be written to support English + FR/DE/JP in the first release; strings tracked in i18n spreadsheet.
engineering_tasks: ENG-41210: API endpoint for bulk suggested roles (returns roles with confidence and rationale).
ENG-41211: Effective-permissions preview API that translates role -> user-facing examples.
ENG-41212: Audit write path for role decisions with metadata (suggestion_source, approver, duration).
ENG-41300: Frontend wizard screens, CTA patterns, and undo snackbar integration.
review_feedback: PM (Ethan Liu): prefer conservative default to least-privilege suggestion for enterprise customers.
Security (Aisha Raman): require explicit approval for any assignment that grants data export or admin-level role.
Engineering (Samira Nadeem): bulk limits need to be validated against current job queue capacity; suggested 250->500 cap.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-reliance on automated suggestions could cause subtle permission creep. Mitigation: prominent rationale, confidence scores, and explicit audit record.
Risk: Latency when computing suggestions for large groups. Mitigation: pre-compute suggestions during SSO sync and cache results for 24 hours.
next_steps: Design handoff package: export final Figma frames and annotation file (target 2026-03-05).
Security review: schedule 1:1 with Security team for approval gating (target 2026-03-08).
Pilot: implement feature flag for 10 pilot orgs to collect telemetry on suggestion accuracy and reversal rate.
